statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-56406: libexpat before 2.8.2 has an integer overflow in XML_ParseBuffer, which lacked an overflow check that XML_Parse has (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-56406). Upstream fixed it in Expat 2.8.2 (libexpat PR #1255, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1255; release notes https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_8_2/expat/Changes). The DHI Alpine expat package is built from Alpine's aports expat recipe, and the only DHI patches in its build definition fix other CVEs. The libexpat package of every build published for Alpine 3.23, on x86_64 and aarch64, reports its Expat version: 2.7.3-r0 to 2.8.1-r0 report Expat 2.7.3 to 2.8.1, and 2.8.2-r0 to 2.10.0-r1 report Expat 2.8.2 to 2.10.0. The range ends at 2.8.2-r0, the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-56406: libexpat before 2.8.2 has an integer overflow in XML_ParseBuffer, which lacked an overflow check that XML_Parse has (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-56406). Upstream fixed it in Expat 2.8.2 (libexpat PR #1255, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1255; release notes https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_8_2/expat/Changes). Debian fixed it for trixie in expat 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6404-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-56406), which updates trixie to Expat 2.8.2. The first DHI expat build made from that Debian version is the lowest one carrying the fix: its libexpat1 package on amd64 and arm64 reports Expat 2.8.2 and its shipped changelog records this CVE. Every later published build is made from a later Debian version based on Expat 2.8.3 or 2.9.0, which also contain the fix. The range ends at that first build. Builds made from Debian's earlier 2.7.1-2 source sort below it and are reported as affected, including builds whose changelog records a backport of this fix.
